acid_splash.source_note: Native acid Tail material: scrolling NoiseTexture2D with the source acid colours. grow_amount=1 is the original scene RESET/open value; the constructor initially samples launch at zero. This selects the actual tail surface because the flame heads have hardcoded geometry displacement with no complete disable uniform.

burning_hands.reason: The native fire surface selects a 64-frame sheet from per-particle COLOR.a and multiplies by COLOR.rgb; other source fire layers use INSTANCE_CUSTOM.z. No independent actor-surface clock/particle-age mapping is authored. Replacing those inputs with arbitrary time or a static terminal frame would be a fabricated material adaptation.

chill_touch.reason: The necrotic hand material is present, but its fragment uses the native world cutplane, rim distance and view-normal Fresnel. It has no cutplane disable switch. A flat unregistered quad would not faithfully preserve its current source inputs; keep colour treatment until an explicit body-compatible native binding is authored.

eldritch_blast.source_note: Actual animated crossed-trail surface with T_VFX_Noise_a13, Overlapping_Gradient and T_VFX_Mask_15. The inner head depends on view-normal Fresnel and becomes transparent on a facing quad; the selected native trail has no such geometry dependency.

fire_bolt.source_note: Actual native outer fire projectile head (m_fireStrikeHead / s_ProjectileSoft_B_Disp), retaining its animated T_VFX_Noise_019, gradient subtraction, HDR g_fireTypeC gradient and fragment opacity. Wave_Intensity is zero because this body treatment preserves the receiver silhouette rather than displacing its mesh.

fireball.source_note: Actual native fireball travel flame: animated Base_noise2, additive/subtractive masks and Gradient_Color_1D2. Existing native switch disables only vertex wobble; noise, gradient, intensity, Fill and fragment opacity remain source values.

guiding_bolt.source_note: Actual gold HDR FireHead with moving source noise minus its original mask. Keep the shader default texture parameters carried by the source Shader resource; get_shader_parameter may report null for those defaults.

ice_knife.source_note: Actual native ice core StandardMaterial3D using T_rocks_I2_blue.webp and source albedo (0.7,0.8,1.6). This is the textured ice material, not an invented animated ice shader; the source effect obtains its motion from geometry and particles.

magic_missile.source_note: Actual native Box1 material with Color1/Color2 and T_VFX_Srt1 mask. Its material is static; the native effect animates the box geometry. Source colours are green before the sandbox finishing ramp, so matching the displayed magenta missile also requires that existing finishing pass rather than new colour parameters.

poison_spray.reason: The source uses particle StandardMaterial3D surfaces; its displayed colour and opacity include per-particle process colour/age and emission geometry. There is no independent native animated body material in the selected scene. Sampling a white-default quad would discard those inputs.

produce_flame.source_note: Actual native flame surface with T_CloudNoise_Tiled, moving subtraction noise and original fire gradient. Only vertex wobble is disabled. The source fresnel_Gradient_1D evaluates to white at facing-normal Fresnel zero, preserving the moving flame colour rather than replacing it with the rim colour.

ray_of_frost.source_note: Actual recovered primary travel material with its source frost gradient and T_VFX_Noise_3. Explicit clip selection distinguishes the second travelIce cue. Existing native vertex switch disables wobble only.

sacred_flame.source_note: Actual holy itemflash surface with native gold HDR Color, T_VFX_Flare_2 and blinking clock. opacity=1 is the native Init hold value from 0.5 through 2.66667 seconds. Use_Proximity_Fade=false selects the shader existing non-depth branch because the isolated material sample has no scene-depth contact. The occurrence envelope owns the short receiver flash.

scorching_ray.source_note: Actual native Scorching Ray outer projectile head, retaining its source fire noise, HDR gradient and opacity. Wave_Intensity disables mesh displacement while the source fragment remains unchanged.

shocking_grasp.reason: The selected native electric spark ShaderMaterial requires particle COLOR.rgb/alpha as authored by its particle process and uses that alpha as the dissolve threshold. It has no independent source-time material animation. A white quad would lose the native colour/dissolve behavior and cannot stand in for the electrical particle effect.

thunderwave.source_note: Actual selected native wave derivative with authored wind noise/mask, source_clock, pulse and finite native fade. Its vertex stage computes only non-displacing height/crest context; the body sample preserves that native stage and fragment. This is the selected authored wave material, not the excluded donor dust particle material.
